svg.title: IronMind — use case diagram
svg.desc: UML use case diagram showing a Registered User actor and a System actor connected to 14 use cases grouped in four domains: authentication, nutrition, hydration, and exercise. Include and extend relationships are shown for strength logging and cardio calorie estimation.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Explain the Register use case in IronMind')
sendPrompt('Explain the Login use case and how the JWT is issued')
sendPrompt('What fields does Log meal require in IronMind?')
sendPrompt('How does View meal logs work in IronMind?')
sendPrompt('How does Delete meal log work in IronMind?')
sendPrompt('What does the hydration daily summary include?')
sendPrompt('How does Set water reminder work?')
sendPrompt('Why does Toggle reminder use PATCH and not PUT?')
sendPrompt('How are sets, reps and weightKg validated in ExerciseService?')
sendPrompt('How does the MET formula estimate calories burned in IronMind?')
sendPrompt('What can a Registered User do in IronMind?')
sendPrompt('What background actions does the IronMind system perform automatically?')

svg.text: All use cases except Register and Login require a valid JWT — enforced by middleware
